sub: Fresh, well-made Hive posts that are still waiting for their first visit, least rewarded first. A vote, a comment or just a read can make someone's day. 🐝
f1: Top-level posts 1–15 hours old, in a community, with pending rewards at or below the median of the moment.
f2: At least 300 words and a quality score: own photos, paragraphs, a personal voice. Generic explainers, news-style articles, hashtag or all-caps titles are left out.
f3: The author is part of the hive: comments on other people's posts in the last week, reputation 30+.
f4: Skipped: public blacklists and community mutes, flood posting, copied text, NSFW, declined payouts, anti-abuse downvotes, posts already linked by other newsletters.
f5: Vote and comment from here: log in with Hive Keychain (browser extension or the Keychain mobile app). Nothing is stored on a server: your keys never leave Keychain.
f6: ⚡ low RC (red edge): the author has under 20% Resource Credits and can hardly comment or reply. Open the post to lend them some RC in one click.
f7: Originality ✓: a sentence of the post was searched on the web and found nowhere else, or only on the author's own pages. ⚠️ text also elsewhere: the same text is on a site under a similar name, to check. ⏳ not checked yet: the check runs a few posts per hour.
stale: the list may be out of date

lb_intro: Two cups every month, each with its own podium. 🎁 The prize pool is the month's curation rewards of {pp}: half for each cup, split 60% / 25% / 15% among its top 3, paid liquid or in HP. 🍯 {n} posts curated this month.

lb_note: A post counts as curated when you comment it with the Wildflower Watch signature (from this page). Rewards given = value of your votes on those posts (≈ at today's HIVE price). The same bee can win both cups. 🐝 = our own accounts (@hive3 team): they stay in the ranking and also count the posts they only voted, but they are not eligible for prizes: medals go to the first 3 curators outside the team. Updated every hour.
